original.value: A dramatic Japanese light-novel cover illustration in high-detail anime fantasy style, square composition, showing a heroic ensemble posed for battle in a ruined mountain pass at sunset with cherry blossoms blowing through the air. The scene centers on {argument name="hero title" default="Momotaro"}, a young black-haired male warrior in glossy red samurai armor, crouched in the foreground and gripping a katana diagonally across his body. Beside him in the front-right foreground is a black-haired young woman in matching red armor with a high ponytail, also drawing a katana in a dynamic combat-ready pose. Around them stand 5 additional companions for a total of 7 characters: 1 brown-haired short-haired girl at front-left holding a short blade, 1 silver-haired angelic woman at upper-left with large white wings and a drawn bow, 1 tall red-haired warrior at top-center carrying a large weapon over the shoulder, 1 long straight black-haired shrine-maiden-like girl at upper-center-right in white and red with light armor, and 1 blonde girl at right holding a large ornate war hammer. Add a distant Japanese castle on the right background, jagged rocks and broken ground, glowing embers, drifting petals, and a luminous cloudy sky with strong backlight behind the group. Use cinematic fantasy lighting, epic adventure mood, polished painterly rendering, sharp detailed armor, flowing hair, layered depth, and a bold heroic poster feel. Include large Japanese title text across the top in metallic gold with black outline reading {argument name="top title text" default="《御伽話ファンタジー》シン・桃太郎伝"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it in white with dark outline reading {argument name="top subtitle text" default="～追放・転生した元神は、おとぎ話の世界の美少女たちと世界を救う!!"}. Include large Japanese promotional text across the bottom in bright red with white outline reading {argument name="bottom catch text" default="追放、転生した神・桃太郎。御伽話の美少女たちと試練乗り越えて鬼退治！"}. Make it look like a commercial fantasy web novel or manga cover image, energetic, crowded, and visually striking.

zh-CN.value: 戏剧性的日本轻小说封面插画，高细节动漫奇幻风格，方形构图，展示英雄团队在日落时分的风化山隘中摆出战斗姿势，樱花在空中飘落。场景中心是{argument name="hero title" default="Momotaro}"，一位年轻的黑发男性武士，穿着闪亮的红色武士盔甲，蹲在前景中，双手斜握着一把武士刀横在身前。在他右侧的前景中，是一位黑发年轻女子，同样穿着配套的红色盔甲，扎着高马尾，也以动态的战斗姿态拔出武士刀。他们周围站着5位额外的同伴，总共7个角色：1位左前方的棕色短发女孩手持短刃，1位左上方的银发天使般女子长着白色大翅膀并拉开弓，1位顶中央的高个子红发战士肩扛大型武器，1位右上中央的直长黑发巫女般女孩穿着白色和红色的轻盔甲，以及1位右侧的金发女孩手持大型华丽战锤。在右侧背景添加一座遥远的日本城堡，崎岖的岩石和破碎的地面，发光的余烬，飘落的花瓣，以及一个发光的多云天空，在群体后方有强烈的背光。使用电影般的奇幻照明，史诗冒险氛围，精致绘画般的渲染，精细的盔甲细节，飘逸的头发，层次深度，以及大胆的英雄海报感。在顶部包含大型日语标题文本，金属金色配黑色轮廓，内容为{argument name="top title text" default="《御伽話ファンタジー》シン・桃太郎伝"}，下方有较小的日语副标题，白色配深色轮廓，内容为{argument name="top subtitle text" default="～追放・転生した元神は、おとぎ話の世界の美少女たちと世界を救う!!"}。在底部包含大型日语宣传文本，亮红色配白色轮廓，内容为{argument name="bottom catch text" default="追放、転生した神・桃太郎。御伽話の美少女たちと試練乗り越えて鬼退治！"}。使其看起来像商业奇幻网络小说或漫画封面图像，充满活力，拥挤，且视觉冲击力强。
